args.title: Add setup instructions for MinIO in README
args.body:
File: README.md

Add instructions to set `S3_ENDPOINT` when using MinIO for local development. This includes setting `S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000` and creating a MinIO bucket, in response to confusion caused when uploads were attempted to AWS instead.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue stems from missing setup instructions in the README.md for configuring `S3_ENDPOINT` when using MinIO for local development. This led to uploads being directed to AWS instead. The proposed update includes instructions for setting this environment variable and creating a bucket in MinIO.
